chain_words.nuance: to make small changes to an existing practice
to change something to suit new conditions
to introduce new methods or ideas
to be among the first to develop a new approach
to change an entire field fundamentally through new ideas

explanation: These words all describe bringing change in technology and society, from small adjustments to a fundamental revolution in a field.

usage_notes.difference: 'Innovate' means introducing new methods; 'revolutionize' means changing an entire field so fundamentally that it is transformed.
